verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://loops.so/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a structured product summary, and llms.txt entries link to migration guides and Content API docs. Loops also runs a dedicated /agents docs section (API, CLI, MCP, skills, LMX, migrate) and serves a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at /openapi.json, so an agent has several agent-oriented entry points. Missing for 10: markdown doc variants (docs.md returns 404) and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents actually consuming these docs.
